title: Extraction Protocol for Untargeted LC-MS/MS from Animal Tissues
author: Mauricio Caraballo
materials: TissueLyser II (Bead Mill, QIAGEN, 85300, https://www.qiagen.com/us/products/human-id-and-forensics/automation/tissuelyser-ii/#orderinginformation ) Legend RT (Refrigerated Benchtop Centrifuge, Sorvall, sorvall legend rt, https://knowledge1.thermofisher.com/Lab_Equipment/Centrifuges/Table_Top_Centrifuges/Table_Top_Centrifuge_Operator_Manuals/Sorvall_Legend_T_Plus%2C_RT_Plus_Instruction_Manual ) Centrifuge 5418 (Centrifuge, Eppendorf US, Catalog No. 5401000137, https://www.eppendorf.com/us-en/eShop-Products/Centrifugation/Microcentrifuges/Centrifuge-5418R-p-5401000137 ) Sonicator (Branson, B2510)
Homogenize at 30 Hz for 8 min in a Qiagen TissueLyzer II.

2 mL Qiagen sample tubes (catalog no. 990381) Stainless Steel Beads (Qiagen, Inc., 5 mm diameter, Cat. No. NC9257481) Shallow polypropylene 96-well plate (Cat. No. 951040048) Deep polypropylene 96-well plate (Cat. No. 951033405) Seal plates (Cat. No. ZAFPE50) Note: for LC-MS/MS acquisition AlumaSeal CS (Sealing Foil, Excel Scientific) (Cat. No. FC100) Note: for long time storage Metal tweezers Bead dispenser Wash the stainless steel beads with LC-MS grade water followed by LC-MS methanol in a glass Petri dish then allow to dry overnight.

steps.title: Prepare solvents
steps.instruction: Prepare extraction solvent (50% v/v methanol:water) using LC‑MS grade water and methanol. Prepare resuspension solvent (50% v/v methanol:water) spiked with 1 µM sulfadimethoxine (CAS 122‑11‑2) as internal standard.

steps.title: Inspect and label received samples
steps.instruction: Verify each plastic centrifuge tube contains 1 mL 95 % ethanol; if an ink label is inside, remove it with tweezers disinfected with methanol. Label the tube externally with a sticker or marker.

steps.title: Dry received samples
steps.instruction: Place the tubes in a Centrivap and dry according to the instrument protocol.

steps.title: Label empty sample tubes
steps.instruction: Prepare empty sample tubes and label them uniquely for later transfers.

steps.title: Add bead and extraction solvent
steps.instruction: Using the bead dispenser, add one bead to each empty sample tube, then add 1 mL of the 50% methanol:water extraction solvent.

substeps.instruction: Add one bead per tube with dispenser
Add 1 mL extraction solvent to each tube

steps.title: Incubate extraction
steps.instruction: Incubate the tubes at 4 °C for 1 hour to allow protein precipitation.

steps.title: Centrifuge extracts
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes at 14 000 rpm, 4 °C for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant to plates
steps.instruction: Transfer a total of 800 µL supernatant from each tube into two labeled deep 96‑well polypropylene plates (400 µL per plate). Label the plates and designate one as a backup for storage at –80 °C.

steps.title: Dry plates
steps.instruction: Dry the deep‑well plates using a Centrivap.

steps.title: Seal and store plates
steps.instruction: Seal the plates and store them at –80 °C until LC‑MS/MS analysis.

steps.title: Reconstitute samples
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of the resuspension solvent (50% methanol:water with 1 µM sulfadimethoxine) to each well of the analysis plate.

steps.title: Seal and sonicate
steps.instruction: Seal the reconstituted plate and sonicate for 15 minutes (00:15:00).

steps.title: Vortex to solubilize
steps.instruction: Hand‑shake or vortex the plate to ensure complete solubilization of the sample.

steps.title: Transfer to shallow plate
steps.instruction: Transfer the solution to a shallow polypropylene 96‑well plate; if particles or turbidity are observed, centrifuge the plate at 2000 rpm, 4 °C for 15 minutes and transfer the clarified supernatant to a new shallow plate.

substeps.instruction: Transfer clarified supernatant to new shallow plate

steps.title: Prepare plate for LC‑MS/MS
steps.instruction: Use the final shallow 96‑well plate for LC‑MS/MS acquisition.
